integrity: The proof is exact and algebraic. A symbolic replay reconstructs the chord endpoints and areas directly from the normalized vertices and verifies the displayed identities. Numerical experiments are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The scalar bound rho >= 24/25 and its quadrilateral equality class are prior work; the new content is the full two-modulus formula, exact defect decomposition, and monotonic reduction.
The result is confined to planar strictly convex quadrilaterals and does not solve the analogous minimization over all convex bodies.
An unindexed note or unpublished symbolic worksheet could conceivably contain the same simplification; no such public source was located.
title: Exact defect decomposition for quadrilateral centroid-chord asymmetry
